# Epistemic Memory Spec

> Pre-standard public research draft for provenance-bound, human-governed
> epistemic memory. Not a protocol, schema, conformance suite, reference
> implementation, or compatibility claim.

## Authority and reading order

1. [Status](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/STATUS.md) and [Charter](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/CHARTER.md) define current boundaries.
2. [Versioning](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/VERSIONING.md) defines maturity terms.
3. [Research Draft v0](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/spec/epistemic-memory-research-draft-v0.md) defines
   proposed concepts and non-goals.
4. [Evidence and Review](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/docs/evidence-and-review.md) defines evidence classes
   and review boundaries.

## Participation

Read [Start Here](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/START_HERE.md), [Contributing](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), and
[Open Research](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/blob/main/OPEN_RESEARCH.md). Use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/issues/new/choose) for evidence-backed work and [Discussions](https://github.com/MarcoPorcellato/epistemic-memory-spec/discussions) for exploratory dialogue.

## Safety boundary

Canonical sources remain authoritative. Use synthetic or redacted material;
never publish private source content, prompts, paths, credentials, or vault
data. This file is navigation only. It grants no authority to act, does not
override maintained documents, and does not establish truth, endorsement, or
compatibility from a retrieved link.
